verdict.rationale: Honeybadger supports natural-language search via a 'Describe your search' panel that translates plain-language descriptions into BadgerQL queries, and its MCP server lets a connected AI assistant fetch data, run BadgerQL queries, and investigate issues conversationally. However, most core operations (deployments, alarms, integrations, CLI) still rely on structured queries/commands rather than direct natural-language control, and there's no independent evidence of how robust the NL search feature is in practice. Missing for 10: broader native NL command support across all product areas, independent/hands-on validation of NL search accuracy.
